style.look: High-end 2D fantasy RPG battle visual effect for a HD-2D pixel-art game: hand-painted, crisp, clean bold shapes with fine painterly detail, luminous glow, vivid saturated colours, strong value contrast, dynamic anime-style energy shapes, readable silhouette at small size.
style.mono: Render the whole effect in monochrome only: pure white hot core fading through light grey to dark grey at the edges, absolutely no hue, no colour tint, so it can be recoloured later.
style.black: Background: perfectly flat pure black (#000000) everywhere, no gradient, no texture, no vignette, no stars, no ground, no floor, no reflections.
style.clear: Background: fully transparent; the effect has clean edges and no ground plane, no cast shadow, no backdrop.
style.neg: No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no frame outlines, no panels, no characters, no creatures, no weapons, no hands, no UI.

parts.prompt: A fire explosion burst animation: frame 1 a small bright yellow-white flash, frames 2-4 a roaring ball of orange and red flame expanding outward with curling flame tongues and flying embers, frames 5-7 the flames breaking apart into licks of fire and dark-red smoky edges, frame 8 faint dying embers. Hot white-yellow core, orange body, deep red rim.

An ice crystal burst animation: frame 1 a tiny cold blue spark, frames 2-4 sharp translucent ice crystal shards erupting outward in a star-shaped cluster with frosty mist, frames 5-7 the crystals cracking and shattering into glittering fragments flying apart, frame 8 a few fading sparkles of frost. Pale cyan and white highlights, deep blue facets, glossy faceted crystals with bright rim light.

A lightning strike animation: a jagged forked lightning bolt falling from the top of each cell straight down to a bright impact point at the bottom of the cell. Frame 1 a thin leader stroke, frames 2-3 the full blinding bolt with branches and an electric flash ball at the impact point, frame 4 a different jagged shape of the same bolt flickering, frames 5-6 thin fading electric filaments and sparks. White-hot core, electric yellow and violet-blue glow.

A sword slash arc animation: a big sharp crescent-moon shaped blade trail sweeping diagonally from upper-left to lower-right. Frame 1 a thin bright line starting, frames 2-3 the crescent swinging through with a razor-sharp leading edge and a soft motion-blur tail, frame 4 the full crescent at its brightest with a small star glint, frames 5-8 the crescent thinning, breaking into streaks and dissolving.

An impact hit spark animation: frame 1 a tiny intense point flash, frame 2 a sharp four-pointed star burst with thin radial spikes, frame 3 the largest burst with a ring of short speed-line sparks flying outward, frames 4-5 the spikes shrinking and scattered spark streaks, frame 6 a few fading specks.

A healing magic animation: soft emerald-green and mint light rising upward from the bottom of each cell: gentle glowing motes, small four-pointed twinkling stars and a few translucent leaf-shaped light petals spiralling upward around a soft vertical glow. Frame 1 faint, frames 2-5 growing and rising, frames 6-8 drifting higher and fading. Warm white sparkle cores, green and aqua glow.

A heavy greatsword cleave animation: a very thick, wide crescent blade trail smashing diagonally downward from upper-left to lower-right, with a heavy weighty leading edge, a blast of short spark streaks and a burst of shock lines at the end of the swing. Frames 1-3 the swing building fast, frame 4 the full thick crescent with an impact flare, frames 5-8 the trail breaking into fragments and fading.

A straight sword slash line animation: a perfectly straight, horizontal, razor-thin cut line of light across the cell, tapered sharply at both ends. Frame 1 a tiny spark at the left, frames 2-3 the line racing to the right, frame 4 the full brilliant line with a bright flare in the middle, frames 5-8 the line splitting into a thin afterimage gap and dissolving into tiny glints.

A cross slash animation: two sharp crescent blade trails crossing in an X shape. Frames 1-2 the first diagonal slash, frames 3-4 the second diagonal slash crossing it with a bright star flare at the crossing point, frames 5-8 the X glowing then fracturing into glinting shards and fading.

A rapid multi-slash flurry animation: many thin quick crescent cuts appearing one after another at different angles around the centre, criss-crossing, with small glints at each cut. Frames 1-6 more and more cuts piling up, frames 7-8 the cuts flashing and fading.

A spinning whirlwind blade ring animation seen at a slight top-down angle: an elliptical ring of sharp crescent blade trails rotating around the centre, with motion-blur streaks and sparks flung outward. Each frame is the ring rotated a little further; seamless loop.

A piercing thrust animation pointing to the right: a sharp spear-tip shaped streak of light shooting from left to right, a long tapered tail behind it and a bright pointed tip with a small cone-shaped shock flare at the front. Frames 1-3 the streak shooting forward, frame 4 full length with a burst at the tip, frames 5-8 the streak thinning and fading to sparkles.

A single glowing magic arrow of light flying to the right: a sharp arrowhead at the right end, a slim shaft and a long fading comet-like light trail with tiny sparkles trailing to the left. Horizontal, centred.

A critical hit impact flash animation: frame 1 a bright compact flash, frame 2 a huge eight-pointed star burst with long thin light rays and a round shock ring, frame 3 the ring expanding with broken spark fragments, frames 4-6 rays shrinking, ring fading into scattered glints.

A sharp slashing hit spark animation: frame 1 a small hot point, frame 2 a burst of jagged sharp splinter-like spark spikes radiating unevenly, frame 3 the largest burst with flying spark streaks curving outward, frames 4-6 streaks scattering and fading.

A blunt heavy impact animation: frame 1 a white flash, frame 2 a round bursting shock puff with a thick bright ring and a stubby star in the middle, frame 3 the ring widening with heavy chunky debris sparks flying out, frames 4-6 ring breaking into fragments and fading.

A single circular shockwave ring of energy, front view: a thin very bright crisp ring line with a soft glow halo inside and outside, a few small spark flecks along the ring and faint wispy distortion streaks. Perfect circle, empty centre.

A single ornate glowing magic circle seen straight from above: concentric glowing rings, an outer band of mysterious runic glyph symbols (invented, not real letters), an inner seven-pointed star polygon, small orbiting dots, delicate geometric lines, all glowing light lines. Perfect circle, symmetric, flat.

A single glowing summoning magic circle seen straight from above: a hexagram of two interlocking triangles inside double rings, crescent moon motifs and small circles at the six points, a ring of abstract rune marks (invented, not real letters), fine filigree lines, all glowing light lines. Perfect circle, symmetric, flat.

A single tall vertical pillar of holy light rising from a small bright elliptical glowing spot at the bottom to the top of the image: a brilliant white core column, soft glowing edges, faint vertical light streaks and small rising sparkles, fading out softly at the very top.

A single radial burst of light rays seen front-on: many long sharp tapering god-ray beams of varied lengths radiating from a bright small central sun point, soft glow at the centre, rays fading to nothing at the tips.

A charging energy orb animation: a glowing sphere of crackling magical energy with a bright core, swirling inner wisps and small particles being drawn inward from around it, a soft outer glow. The orb pulses and the wisps rotate from frame to frame; seamless loop.

A twinkling sparkle cluster animation: a loose cluster of crisp four-pointed star glints and tiny glowing dots of varied sizes; frame 1 a few faint dots, frames 2-5 more stars blooming and twinkling with cross flares, frames 6-8 stars shrinking and fading one by one.

A rising battle aura animation: a flickering column of upward-flowing aura flames and light streaks rising from a glowing ellipse at the bottom of each cell, with small particles floating upward, flame tongues licking up and wavering; seamless loop.

A fireball projectile flying to the right animation: a blazing round fireball with a white-yellow hot head at the right and a long swirling tail of orange and red flame and embers streaming to the left; the flames flicker and swirl differently each frame; seamless loop. Horizontal, centred in each cell.

An erupting pillar of fire animation: a tall column of roaring flame bursting up from the bottom of each cell. Frame 1 a small flame burst at the bottom, frames 2-4 a towering pillar of swirling orange and yellow flame with a white-hot base and flying embers, frames 5-6 the pillar breaking into licking flames and smoke-red embers fading upward.

A wide patch of burning ground flames animation: a low wide row of flickering flame tongues of different heights burning along the bottom of each cell, bright yellow at the base, orange and red tips, small embers rising; the flames dance differently each frame; seamless loop.

A big water splash animation: frame 1 a small droplet impact at the bottom, frames 2-4 a crown-shaped burst of clear blue water erupting upward and outward with droplets and white foam highlights, frames 5-7 the water falling back in arcs of droplets, frame 8 small fading droplets. Glossy translucent water with bright specular highlights.

A swirling water vortex animation seen at a slight top-down angle: a spiral whirlpool of rushing blue water currents and white foam spinning around a dark centre, with droplets flung out; each frame rotated further; seamless loop.

An ice crystal eruption animation: frames 1-3 a cluster of large sharp ice crystal spikes growing up out of the bottom of each cell with frost mist, frame 4 the full tall glittering crystal cluster with bright rim light, frames 5-6 cracks spreading through it, frames 7-8 the crystals shattering into flying ice shards and fading frost. Pale cyan and white, deep blue facets.

A wind blade animation: several sharp crescent-shaped blades of swirling green-and-mint wind cutting across from right to left, with thin airflow streaks and a few torn leaves. Frames 1-3 blades forming and flying, frame 4 brightest, frames 5-8 blades dispersing into curling wisps.

A swirling tornado animation: a tall funnel of spiralling mint-green and white wind bands, narrow at the bottom of each cell and wide at the top, with debris specks and leaves caught in the spiral; the spiral bands rotate from frame to frame; seamless loop.
A circular gust of wind animation: curved streamlines of air spiralling around the centre in a loose ring, with motion streaks and small particles; each frame rotated a little further; seamless loop.

A rock eruption animation: chunks of brown and grey stone and dirt bursting up out of the ground at the bottom of each cell. Frame 1 the ground cracking, frames 2-4 jagged rock chunks and gravel blasting upward with dust, frames 5-7 rocks falling back, frame 8 a little settling dust. Painterly shaded rocks with warm highlights.

A stone spike attack animation: a row of sharp jagged stone spikes thrusting up out of the ground at the bottom of each cell. Frames 1-3 the spikes shooting up with rubble, frame 4 tallest with flying pebbles, frames 5-8 the spikes crumbling and sinking back into dust. Earthy brown and grey rock, warm highlights.
A tumbling boulder animation: one jagged chunk of brown-grey rock rotating in place, each frame rotated further; seamless loop. Painterly shading, warm highlights.

A ground dust burst animation: a low wide cloud of tan and grey dust billowing outward along the ground at the bottom of each cell, frames 1-3 bursting out, frames 4-6 rolling wider and softer, frames 7-8 thinning away. Soft painterly puffs.

An electric burst animation: frame 1 a bright spark, frames 2-4 a crackling sphere of electricity with jagged lightning arcs shooting outward in all directions, frames 5-7 arcs flickering in new shapes and shrinking, frame 8 small fading sparks. White-hot core, electric yellow and violet-blue glow.

A holy light burst animation: frame 1 a small radiant point, frames 2-4 a blinding cross-shaped burst of golden-white light with a radiant ring and soft feather-like light particles, frames 5-7 the cross fading and the ring widening with sparkles, frame 8 faint glints. Warm white and gold.

A pulsing dark magic orb animation: a sphere of swirling black-violet shadow energy with a deep purple glowing rim, wisps of shadow smoke curling around it and small violet sparks orbiting; seamless loop.
A void vortex animation: a spiral black hole of dark purple energy with glowing magenta-violet spiral arms, particles being pulled into its dark centre; each frame rotated further; seamless loop.

A shadow spikes animation: sharp black-violet thorns of shadow energy with glowing purple edges stabbing up out of a dark pool at the bottom of each cell. Frames 1-3 rising, frame 4 tallest with violet sparks, frames 5-8 dissolving into dark smoke wisps.
A poison bubbles animation: sickly purple and toxic-green glowing bubbles rising and popping from a small bubbling puddle at the bottom of each cell, with faint toxic vapour; seamless loop.

A curse smoke animation: swirling dark purple and grey-violet smoke wisps coiling around the centre and sinking downward, with a few dim violet sparkles. Frame 1 faint, frames 2-5 thickest, frames 6-8 dissipating. Soft painterly smoke.

A smoke puff animation: a round cloud of soft light-grey smoke bursting outward from the centre: frame 1 small, frames 2-4 billowing round puffs expanding, frames 5-8 thinning, drifting and fading. Soft painterly shading.

A swirling leaves animation: a ring of bright green leaves and a few pale blossom petals spiralling around the centre in a loose elliptical orbit seen at a slight angle; each frame the leaves move further around; seamless loop.

A falling meteor animation, flying toward the lower-right: a glowing molten rock head at the lower-right with a long blazing tail of fire, smoke and sparks streaking back to the upper-left; the fire flickers each frame; seamless loop.

A monster claw strike animation: three parallel jagged claw-scratch slashes tearing diagonally from upper-left to lower-right. Frame 1 tips appearing, frames 2-3 the three slashes ripping through with a sharp bright edge and spark tears, frames 4-6 the gashes fading.

A bite attack animation: two curved rows of sharp glowing fang shapes, an upper jaw and a lower jaw, snapping shut toward the centre. Frames 1-2 jaws open wide, frame 3 jaws clamping shut with an impact flash, frames 4-6 the flash and fang marks fading.

A single giant spectral sword made of solid glowing light, pointing straight down: an ornate crossguard near the top, a long broad blade tapering to a sharp point at the bottom, engraved rune lines on the blade, bright glowing edges and a soft aura. Vertical, centred.

A single giant spectral war hammer made of solid glowing light, head pointing straight down: a long handle at the top, a massive ornate rectangular hammer head at the bottom with engraved rune lines, bright glowing edges, crackling energy and a soft aura. Vertical, centred.

A single glowing ground fissure seen from a low three-quarter angle: jagged branching cracks radiating outward from a centre point across flat ground, the cracks glowing brightly from inside with light seeping up, small floating particles. Only the glowing cracks, no visible ground texture.
